name: USW-Aggregation
title: Switch Aggregation
summary: 8-port 10G SFP+ L2 rack switch for aggregating 10G uplinks between switches/servers.
gotchas: All 8 ports are SFP+ cages with no RJ45 — every link needs an SFP+ module, DAC, or 10GBASE-T module.
Layer 2 only — no inter-VLAN routing; L3 aggregation needs a USW-Pro-class L3 switch or the gateway.
Only 8 ports and 1000 VLANs; a 24-port 10G/25G core (e.g. USW-Pro-XG / ECS line) for bigger cores.
Needs a UniFi console/gateway to adopt.
best_for: 10G backbone between a gateway, NAS and several PoE switches
